name: Pánd (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a yellow lower hoist part and a blue upper fly part, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pánd: a blue and yellow shield with a black bird, a star and a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
